Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.s_code_type is null) then
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 
 select mc.code_desc into :ctrl_blk_1.s_code_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'TYPES'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_code_type
 and sysdate between mc.eff_date and
 nvl(mc.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'TYPES'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_code_type
 and sysdate between mc.eff_date and
 nvl(mc.term_date, v_local_date+1)
 and nvl(mc.restrict_edit, :GLOBAL.restrict_edit) in (:GLOBAL.restrict_edit, 'ADM00');
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1302');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 go_block ('master_code');
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_code_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 create_record;
 :master_code.ctrl_last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 :master_code.modified_by := :banner.user_id;
 :master_code.code_type := :ctrl_blk_1.s_code_type;
 :master_code.eff_date := v_local_date;
 :master_code.program_id := 'EQIMASTR';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 execute_query;
 GO_ITEM ('code');
end;

begin
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:master_code.eff_date, 'MM-DD-YY');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 if (:master_code.eff_date is null) then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:system.record_status in ('INSERT', 'NEW')) then
 if (:master_code.eff_date < trunc(sysdate)) then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUPLICATE_CODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_DUPLICATE_CODE IS
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 if (:GLOBAL.restrict_edit != 'ADM00') then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_master_codes emc
 where emc.code_type = :master_code.code_type
 and emc.code = :master_code.code
 and emc.restrict_edit is not null
 and emc.restrict_edit != :GLOBAL.restrict_edit;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when too_many_rows then
 :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then 
 show_error ('5238');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 :GLOBAL.code_value := :master_code.code;
 go_record ('1');
 while (:SYSTEM.last_record != 'TRUE') loop
 if ((:GLOBAL.code_value = :master_code.code) and 
 (:GLOBAL.cursor_record != :SYSTEM.cursor_record)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 show_error ('5238');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 down;
 end loop;
--
 if ((:GLOBAL.code_value = :master_code.code) and 
 (:GLOBAL.cursor_record != :SYSTEM.cursor_record)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 show_error ('5238');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
--
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
END;
